T_red.rule: p99.99 of CONTROL in-sheet (+-20 um) voxels > 0 at mesh-valid px of eligible control tiles, uint8 percentile rule 'smallest v with CDF >= q'; per scan (C for E1, C2 for E2)
T_red.note: if the rule gives 255, hi = saturated voxels (== 255)

per_px: h(px) = number of slab voxels >= T_red

block.d_min_rule: block hi-px fraction threshold = max(0.05, p99.9 of CONTROL block fractions)

planarity.rule: depth of hi voxels relative to centre slice, per component

tile_score: S = total area (mm2) of components passing extent, block count and planarity

hotspot.rule: DECL-P4-10 item 4: non-labelled-adjacent tile (p4-excl excl_d_a for E1, excl_a union for E2), S > p99 of {control tile S} U {rot-90 control tile S}, and in-sheet fraction f_in >= 0.8 recomputed over +-20 um vs 60-120 um gap slabs at the component px

injection.fill: granular: pigment volume fraction 0.5 within a layer 2x the equivalent thickness, lateral grain texture = Gaussian random field (sigma 5 um) thresholded at its median, seed per location
injection.letters: Greek capitals from {A,E,H,I,K,L(Lambda),M,N,O,P(Pi),R(Rho),S(Sigma),T}, polyline glyphs, height U(2,4) mm, stroke U(0.3,0.6) mm, seed 20260926
injection.depth: layer top at centre slice + U(-10,+10) um
injection.psf: Gaussian, sigma 2 voxels in depth and 1 voxel in-plane (primary); sigma 1 voxel isotropic (secondary)
injection.locations: >= 10 control + >= 10 title-strip, 5 x 5 mm patches drawn by numpy default_rng(20260926) among mesh-valid in-scan tile interiors
injection.recovered: the patch's detector S (with the letter) > hotspot threshold AND >= 50 % of the planted letter's area overlaps a passing component
injection.sensitive_bar: recovery >= 0.8 at 2 um HgS and PbO under the pessimistic calibration (DECL-P4-10 item 3)

false_positive: fraction of control tiles and rot-90 control tiles with S > hotspot threshold (by construction <= ~1 %); plus per-patch FP on un-injected patches
